newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Chemical to continue $1.6 bln plan.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Chemical to continue $1.6 bln plan.

text.p: Eastman Chemical Co said on Tuesday it plans to continue its $1.6 billion capital program in its core businesses over the next two years.

The company said in a statement that Chairman and Chief Executive Earnest Deavenport told a chemical conference that he expects capital spending to be about $750 million in 1996 and about $850 million in 1997.
The current expansion projects include manufacturing plants in Mexico, Spain, Argentina, Rotterdam, Singapore, Malaysia, Columbia, S.C., and Longview, Texas.
